Game Overview

Angry Block puts players into a arcade experience centered on guide a bouncing block upward in this fast-paced, browser-based adventure. Master the balance of impeccable timing and quick reflexes to dodge spikes and overcome obstacles. As you rise, the challenge intensifies, demanding ever sharper precision. Can you soar to new heights and achieve the ultimate score?
